definitions.sourced: A coder assigned a binary value backed by a dated primary source, audited against the design matrix. NOT independently reviewed.
definitions.reviewed: Sourced AND scored blind by a second reviewer, with agreement and Cohen's kappa computed. This is the only state that supports a reliability claim.
definitions.pending: Held for adjudication. Carries no value; never defaults to zero.
definitions.provisional: Present in the design matrix only. No evidence, no source, no review.

reviewed_scope.note: Cohen's kappa applies ONLY to these cells. It is not a reliability statistic for the six-asset core, which has not been independently reviewed.

headline: 124 of 250 cells are evidence-backed (10 of those independently reviewed); 6 pending, 120 provisional.
